name: physics-papers
about: Statements as papers state them, from three sources. doc: the 50 statements of '50 Representative LaTeX Statements in Quantum Physics' (15 alphaXiv papers), each asked twice, its formula as latex and its title as text. palomar: the physics entries of the Palomar registry (data.palomar-registry.org, metadata CC0), asked by title and the abstract's first sentence. claude: statements Claude wrote for areas the libraries cover. The answers are the declarations that state each result or define its objects, chosen by Claude from the corpus (names, signatures, descriptions) without pisa's search, and not reviewed by a physicist; a statement with none has no counterpart in Mathlib, Physlib, QuantumInfo or PhyslibAlpha.

Superfluid stiffness and nonclassical rotational inertia of the dilute hard-sphere Bose gas. Lean 4 formalization of the principal superfluid-stiffness, nonclassical rotational-inertia, winding, and high-temperature normal-phase results of the supplied manuscript, with concrete hard-sphere path measures and Dirichlet-form response definitions.

Absolutely maximally entangled states of seven parties: for d >= 2, AME(7, d) exists exactly when d >= 3. A machine-checked proof of the Osterwalder-Schrader correspondence between Euclidean Schwinger functions and relativistic Wightman distributions, in both directions, for every spatial dimension d >= 1.
